visualCharacteristics.purpose: stats layout: a feature panel (photo + large figure such as "20 million+" and caption) beside a column of illustrated stat items

contentPattern.structure: one row, two cells: cell 1 = one photo plus figure text (heading or bold paragraph starting with a number) and caption; cell 2 = items each starting with an icon/illustration followed by figure and caption text

usage: Trust/stat strips on office location and service pages.
reuseGuidance: Use for numeric proof points with imagery. Plain text stats can use columns.
